verdict.rationale: The evidence pack includes several pricing-page items, but they describe features such as workflows, integrations, network controls, a model gateway and self-hosting. None mention plan-based daily task limits, concurrency limits, or any UI to view or manage such limits. The axis applies to a cloud-agent platform with paid plans, so the lack of evidence makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can see and manage plan-based daily task and concurrency limits for agent workflows
